intent: A barbarian trophy set: a horned beast-skull helm over smoked hide, a broad wolf-fur mantle and bleached bone trophies, reading from the high camera as pale skull and bone against dark furred hide.
reason: A pale beast-skull helm with horns over dark hide and a wolf-fur mantle reads as 'trophy-taker' at a glance; the skull is the strongest single read on the sheet.
first_fix: The arms read as bare body; check on real avatars that skin, not the dummy's blue, carries the set, and consider a hide bracer so the arm isn't empty.
